label: Reaper patchwork along every coinitial populated descent
definition: CoinitialReaperPatchwork R h Concrete w is ReaperPatchwork restricted to coinitial descents: in every history v accessible from w, along every strictly descending sequence c that runs below every moment earlier than its populated first moment, if every two adjacent local pieces are co-possible from v, some world accessible from v realizes them all. In ordinary language: Reaper pieces placed one per past day back through a beginningless past can be glued into one possible arrangement whenever each neighbouring pair can.
note: Weak version of ReaperPatchwork (coinitialPatchworkOfPatchwork). Anyone who accepts the unrestricted gluing premise accepts this one; the restriction needs no defense when the weak version is what an argument uses. Analyst formulation; attribution deferred. OPEN.
